title: Sinking down and down
literal_meaning: The sunken foot goes down and down.
meaning_odia: ବୁଡ଼ିଯାଇଥିବା ଗୋଡ଼ ଆହୁରି ତଳକୁ ଯାଉଛି—ଏହା ପଙ୍କ୍ତିର ଚିତ୍ର। ଆମ ସମ୍ପାଦକୀୟ ପାଠରେ, ଅବସ୍ଥା ଖରାପ ହେବା ପରେ ଆହୁରି ଖରାପ ହୋଇଚାଲିବାକୁ ଏହା ବୁଝାଇପାରେ। କାହିଁକି ଏପରି ହେଉଛି ବା ଏଥିରୁ ଉଠିବା ଅସମ୍ଭବ କି ନୁହେଁ, ପଙ୍କ୍ତି କହୁନାହିଁ।
explanation: Repeating the downward direction makes the sinking feel unfinished. Read editorially, the line describes a situation that keeps deteriorating after it has already gone wrong. It names the movement, without assigning blame or declaring that recovery is impossible.
usage_example: Original imagined example: A neglected project develops one difficulty after another. Someone describes its worsening condition with the image of a foot sinking down and down.
cultural_context: ତଳକୁ ତଳକୁ carries the whole motion of the short line. The foot supplies a bodily image for a decline that has begun and continues; the source supplies no particular water, mud or other setting.

witnesses.locator: Page31, sixth item beginning ବୁଡିଗଲା ଗୋଡ.
witnesses.note: Rendered upload inspected17November2026; exact spelling without added nukta retained. English goes makes the compressed downward motion explicit. Wider deterioration reading editorial; cause and possibility of recovery unstated.

english_summary: An already difficult situation keeps deteriorating.
